newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cbank 2-wk rev repo sells out at 20 pct max.
newsitem.headline: Czech cbank 2-wk rev repo sells out at 20 pct max.

text.p: Yield in a Czech National Bank (CNB) two-week reverse repo tender to drain liquidity from the market on Monday averaged the maximum set rate of 20 percent the CNB said.
In the last two-week central bank reverse repo the maximum rate was set at 25 percent.
The central bank said it accepted all bids submitted at that level, but did not provide any details on the amount of liquidity drained.
The CNB has been gradually moving the repo rate lower since floating the crown at the end of May.
